spans.s:
भेड भेड, or भेडक, अस्, m. (said by some
to be fr. rt. भिल् with change of ल् into ड्), a ram,
sheep, (in this sense also written भेड्र; cf. एड);
a raft, float [cf. भेल]; N. of a physician; of a
[]
lexicographer; of a Ṛṣi; (ई), f. a ewe; N. of one
of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda (associated with
Eḍī and Sameḍī in Mahā-bh. Śalya-parva 2631).
—भेड-गिरि, इस्, m., N. of a mountain.
भेडर, अस्, m., N. of an Agra-hāra.
